policy: A vendored producer contract may be pinned to an unmerged producer branch only while it is listed here. The entry names the exact producer branch and commit, the producer-published contract digest, an owner, a migration back to a trusted main lock, and an expiry. Nothing here claims that the pinned commit is merged, released, or deployed.

staged_sources.rationale: tempera-payments#47 (branch codex/billing-engine-consolidation) consolidates billing onto Payments and grows the producer contract from 13 to 31 operations and from 5 to 11 scopes. The SDK stages that exact commit now so every generated client carries the refunds, webhook-endpoint, customer, saved-payment-method and PayPal operations while the producer PR is in review. The pin asserts provenance only: 782f0435f757166d36d3e5e4bf783429042a0caf is not merged, released, or deployed.
staged_sources.migration: retire this pin and re-vendor at the main SHA when #47 merges

$comment: A staged pin means the SDK ships a contract that is not released, so it must name an owner, a migration, and an expiry -- and be retired the moment the producer branch merges. Every other vendored producer pins its own main.
